INCIDENT TYPE:
CRYPTOJACKING

DESCRIPTION:
Cryptojacking occurs when attackers secretly use victim computing resources to mine cryptocurrency without authorization. The attack can significantly impact performance and increase operational costs.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1496 | Resource Hijacking

INDICATORS:
- High CPU utilization
- High GPU utilization
- Excessive power consumption
- Mining pool connections
- Browser performance degradation
- Persistent mining processes

DETECTION RULES:
- Persistent high CPU usage
- Connections to mining pools
- Unauthorized process execution

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Endpoints
- Cloud servers
- Containers
title: CRYPTOJACKING
